description: This file defines the DeprecatedTokenParser class within the Twig templating engine. It is responsible for parsing 'deprecated' tags in Twig templates, which are used to indicate deprecated sections or templates. The class extends AbstractTokenParser and implements methods to parse the token stream and generate corresponding DeprecatedNode instances.

classes.name: DeprecatedTokenParser
classes.description: A parser class responsible for handling 'deprecated' tags within Twig templates. It interprets the token stream to create DeprecatedNode instances, allowing developers to mark sections of templates as deprecated with optional package and version information.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the 'deprecated' tag in the token stream, extracting optional parameters such as package and version, and returns a DeprecatedNode.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the string tag identifier 'deprecated' that this parser handles.
